country: Multinational (Arabic, Vietnamese, Italian, Hungarian, Malay, Dutch target languages)
sample_unit: PROM scales translated (Breast-Q and Face-Q scales)

links.outcome: Machine translation quality (METEOR) variation across target languages
links.effect: Forward translation METEOR scores varied significantly by target language for all MT tools (p<0.001); scores differed among translators for all languages except Italian (p=0.59).
links.quote: In forward translations, the METEOR scores significantly varied depending on target languages for all MT tools (p < 0.001), with GPT-4 having the highest scores in most languages.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM machine translation to support human translation of patient-reported outcome measures rather than replacing human translators

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLMs (GPT-4, GPT-3.5) and Google Translate in translating patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) using automated metrics (METEOR), without testing a deployment practice.
